# MSX asset catalogue (Phase 1) - generated by tools/catalog_msx.py; do not edit

One record per game object of the four MSX games, proven from the Z80 code (pattern or
character written by the code, colour as the code sets it) and checked in openMSX captures
of every stage. Pattern numbers are 16x16 sprite numbers as the code uses them (multiples of
4); colours are TMS9918 numbers. No ROM bytes are stored here: the graphics live in the
private evidence folders and contact sheets. Owner rules: docs/DECISIONS.md.

### Nemesis screens

| id | name | kind | shown | emulator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| n1.screen.konami_logo | Konami logo ("Konami" + SOFTWARE) | intro | At power-on and after each attract cycle: mode 0 (p00:$52D7 estado_0) clears the screen, loads the text font, decompresses the logo and raises it one row per call from row 21 to row 7, then writes the message. | yes |
| n1.screen.title_gradius | Title screen, Japanese machines (GRADIUS) | title | Mode 0 sub-step 1 (p00:$52F3) and on any key outside the title; BIOS 0x002B low nibble = 0 (Japanese character set) selects the GRADIUS panel. | yes |
| n1.screen.title_nemesis | Title screen, other machines (NEMESIS) | title | Same as the Japanese title; BIOS 0x002B low nibble != 0 selects the NEMESIS panel (same binary). | yes |
| n1.screen.presentation | Presentation picture with sprites | intro | Attract mode, mode 2 (p00:$5312 estado_2): after the title wait, before the demo. | yes |
| n1.screen.demo | Demo (recorded joystick) | demo | Attract mode after the presentation: p00:$5C88 arranca_la_demo starts stage E006 (cycles 1..8), fully powered (p03:$A0D8, like HYPER), and p00:$5CBE feeds the recorded joystick (bank 12, pairs [frames][value]) with fire held. | yes |
| n1.screen.play_start | Game start: chosen "1PLAYER"/"2PLAYERS" blinking on the title | other | Mode 3 (p00:$537D estado_3) after fire on the title. | yes |
| n1.screen.stage_start | Stage start (HUD set-up; "PLAYER 1"/"PLAYER 2" in two-player games) | interlude | Mode 4 (p00:$53B1 estado_4) before every life: loads the stage font and HUD blocks, writes the HUD; with two players the turn message stays 0x78 frames. | yes |
| n1.screen.pause | Pause (F1) | other | F1 (keyboard row 6 bit 5) toggles pause in play (p00:$44E7); while paused the keyboard cheats are read (p00:$50C9) and only the ship, options and sprite upload run. | yes |
| n1.screen.game_over | Game over ("GAME OVER" / "CONTINUE F5") | gameover | Mode 6 (p00:$546F) with no ships left: sound 0xCA, then mode 7 (p00:$54D9) writes the message and waits for the sound to end; F5 continues. | yes |
| n1.screen.continue | Continue (F5 during game over) | continue | p00:$54F3: F5 (keyboard row 7 bit 1) sets E06F and erases "CONTINUE F5"; when the sound ends the score is cleared, three ships are given and the stage restarts (mode 4). | yes |
| n1.screen.ending_sequence | Ending sequence after the stage-8 boss | cutscene | p01:$6F5E sets E1D0 when the final boss dies with the ship alive; p00:$4AC0 runs ten steps: ship leaves, ending graphics, target and debris, its explosion, the ship approaching in six drawings, border flash, the loop message, BONUS 50000 POINTS (+50000), then stage 1 of the next loop. | yes |

### Nemesis 2 screens

| id | name | kind | shown | emulator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| n2.screen.power_on | Power-on blank screen | intro | State 0 step 0 (0xE1C0=0, 0xE1C1=0) right after reset: blank name table, backdrop colour set through VDP register 7. | yes |
| n2.screen.konami_logo | Konami logo | intro | State 0 steps 1-2: the KONAMI logo appears one pixel row at a time on a blue backdrop, then waits. | yes |
| n2.screen.title_logo_build | Title logo build-up | intro | State 0 step 3: the game logo is decompressed to the RAM screen and shown in steps (fades) before the title texts. | yes |
| n2.screen.title | Title screen (PLAY SELECT) | title | State 1 (and any key during states 0-2, p00:5A3E mandos_del_titulo): logo, (C)KONAMI 1987, PLAY SELECT, 1PLAYER / 2PLAYERS with a blinking arrow cursor; the logo alternates two pictures every 4 frames (p10:B77C). Times out to the demo (state 2). | yes |
| n2.screen.story_prologue_jp | Story prologue text (Japanese MSX only) | story | State 2 (demo) starts the story (p10:A643 empieza_historia): on a Japanese MSX (0x002B low nibble 0) step 1 shows this text page first; other machines start at scene 1 (step 2). | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_01 | Story scene 1: the coup | story | Story step 2 (0xE1D7=2, p10:A088 escena_1) during the demo state 2; next scenes are paced by the interrupt counter 0xF0F7. | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_02 | Story scene 2: Venom exiled | story | Story step 4 (p10:A0C5 escena_2). | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_03 | Story scene 3: escape from Sard | story | Story step 6 (p10:A124 escena_3). | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_04 | Story scene 4: Metalion schematic / search | story | Story step 8 (p10:A177 escena_4). | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_05 | Story scene 5: star map, planets silenced | story | Story step 10 (p10:A1B4 escena_5); during step 11 the picture p10:AFE3 blinks every 8 frames at 0x38AC. | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_06_07 | Story scenes 6-7: the invader was Dr. Venom | story | Story steps 12-17: p10:A207 escena_6 writes the text; p10:A2C5 escena_7 decompresses the big picture p10:AEBD to the RAM screen 0xED00 and reveals it row by row (p10:A35D, p10:A386, fades p10:B0B7/B0CB), then p10:A3C7 removes it and writes the second text. | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_08_10 | Story scenes 8-10: council dispatches Metalion (star map with lights) | story | Story steps 19-23: p10:A40B escena_8 (map and text), p10:A45A escena_9 and p10:A52E escena_10 light up the route one character every 8 frames (p10:A474, table p10:A4DF) with three blinking lights; on the Japanese machine scenes 9 and 10 write further texts. | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_11 | Story scene 11: James Burton chosen (Metalion in the hangar) | story | Story step 24 (p10:A57A escena_11 -> p10:A558 escena_piloto). | yes |
| n2.screen.story_scene_12 | Story scene 12: James Burton (eyes) | story | Story steps 27-31 (p10:A5AE escena_12): picture p10:B06F appears in steps (p10:B0D5, p10:B0DB), text, then fade and p10:A633 historia_acaba; the demo play follows. | yes |
| n2.screen.demo_title | Demo title: KONAMI PRESENTS ... SAGA CONTINUES | demo | State 2 after the story: logo with KONAMI PRESENTS / THE GRADIUS (or NEMESIS) SAGA CONTINUES WITH THE ULTIMATE COSMIC ADVENTURE. | yes |
| n2.screen.demo_play | Demo play (attract mode) | demo | State 2: a stage played by recorded inputs p15:5F6D ([frames][inputs] pairs, 0xFF ends) with 7 captured weapons (p02:81CA); the demo stage cycles 0xE1C6 = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. | yes |
| n2.screen.game_start | Game start (selected option blinks) | option | State 3 step 1: after a button on the title, the chosen 1PLAYER/2PLAYERS text blinks (p03:B25A / p03:B264) with sound 0x3E. | yes |
| n2.screen.pilot_launch | Launch cutscene: Metalion in the hangar | cutscene | State 3 (0xE1D7 steps 1-5, p10:BDFD escena_del_piloto) before the first life: hangar background, the ship rises row by row, its lights/eyes blink, sprites fire and the screen blanks. | yes |
| n2.screen.player_turn | PLAYER 1 / PLAYER 2 (new life) | other | State 4 (new life): with two players the turn text PLAYER 1 or PLAYER 2 (0xE1C2 bit 7) is written over the cleared play field; then play (state 5). | yes |
| n2.screen.play_hud | Play screen with HUD | other | State 5: the bottom row holds lives, 1P score, HI score and the power meter (see n2.hud.* objects). | yes |
| n2.screen.pause | Pause | other | F1 during play (p00:58FD state 9): the game freezes, no pause text is drawn; the keyboard buffer for the second-cartridge keywords is read here (p03:BD7C). | yes |
| n2.screen.game_over | GAME OVER / CONTINUE F5 / HI SCORE and code | gameover | State 7 when lives run out: (PLAYER n with two players) GAME OVER and CONTINUE F5 (F5 sets 0xE20C and continues with score 0 and 3 lives, p00:5942); with no cartridge in the other slot the HI SCORE, the record and a four-digit code computed from it are shown (p00:5C12). | yes |
| n2.screen.boss_destroyed | Boss destroyed (dissolve) | other | In play after a boss core is destroyed: the boss characters dissolve (p11:A2A2 via p01:7438 suceso_final). | yes |
| n2.screen.interior_capture | Boss interior ending: YOU CAPTURED | interlude | End of each boss interior (stage 8, 0xE3C0 steps 1-12, p01:74A2): the ship is moved to the centre, the gate opens (p01:7738) and blinks (p01:7758), the core animates (p01:7565), YOU CAPTURED (p01:7725 with letters p11:B77F) and the prize 0xE444: one weapon (step 8), two weapons (steps 9-11, second label at 0x3498) or NOTHING (p01:7731); then the ship leaves (p11:A2A2). | yes |
| n2.screen.between_stages | Between stages | interlude | State 8 after a stage, interior or the stage-7 interlude: p00:58CF estado_8_vuelve calls p01:7C1C siguiente_fase (next stage, interior after a boss), repaints HUD and meter; the R.DRILL turns back into the ship. | yes |
| n2.screen.return_order | Interlude after stage 7: EMERGENCY, return to Nemesis | cutscene | State 10 with 0xE1D6 = 0 (after the stage-7 boss, p01:7BEA final_del_juego): ending steps from p10:BB7B. Japan: cockpit picture with texts p14:9222 every 300 frames, blinking warning p14:94C4, star-map scene p14:9317 with texts p14:9281, route lights and text p14:9361, then back to play for the return trip (step 9 p10:BACD). Elsewhere: cockpit and DR. VENOM IS FAST APPROACHING NEMESIS! RETURN IMMEDIATELY! (p14:94D1) blinking while the music plays (p10:BA9C), then back to play. | yes |
| n2.screen.ending | Ending (after the final core, stage 0) | ending | State 10 with 0xE1D6 set (stage-0 core destroyed, p01:7A4C guion_fase_0): p10:BBAC final_de_verdad. Japan: step 9 eyes picture, step 10 texts p14:93B4 every 480 frames, step 11 hangar picture with text p14:950F, fade, step 13 final text p10:BC85. Elsewhere: step 11 hangar picture with OPERATIONS TO ERADICATE VENOM WERE ACHIEVED BY METALION... (p10:BC23), fade, final text p10:BD1A (COSMIC YEAR 6667 ... WRITTEN BY EMPEROR LARS THE 18TH). Step 14 waits until frame 0x1518. | yes |
| n2.screen.the_end | THE END / SEE YOU NEXT.... | ending | State 10 sub-steps after the ending (p00:5955): step 2 clears the screen and writes THE END and - EXTEND F5 - (p03:B2AF); without F5 for 600 frames the prompt becomes SEE YOU NEXT.... (p03:B2DB) and the game ends (state 0). | yes |
| n2.screen.extend_f5 | THE END - EXTEND F5 - (play the next loop) | continue | State 10 step 3 (p00:5981): - EXTEND F5 - is offered; with F5 PUSH SPACE KEY (p03:B2CA) appears, with SPACE LET'S START (p03:B2EE) and the game goes on to the next loop (state 8). | yes |

### Nemesis 2 gaps

- {"id": "gap.penguin", "kind": "excluded", "objects": ["n2.player.penguin"], "reason": "Needs the Penguin Adventure cartridge in the other slot (0xF0F5 bit 2, p03:$BCB1). Catalogued from p03:$A879/$A881 and p12:$BF19/$BF82 (sprites), p11:$BF63/$BFBF (characters), marked \"excluded\": \"owner decision\"; not run in the emulator."}
- {"id": "gap.other_cartridges", "kind": "not_proven", "objects": ["n2.hud.meter_labels", "n2.player.metalion"], "reason": "Other second-cartridge features are catalogued but not excluded (the brief excludes only Penguin Adventure/Pentarou for Nemesis 2) and were not run with the real cartridge: Maze of Galious keeps the equipment and offers the BACK UP meter box (label 1 of p14:$9BD3, p02:$8E7C, p01:$7DD9); Q*bert enables the pause keywords LARS18TH/NEMESIS/METALION (p03:$BD7C, words p03:$BEB0); METALION gives the untouchable colour 3 (0xE446) frame of n2.player.metalion. None of them was run with the cartridge; the keywords were not typed."}
- {"id": "gap.unused_enemy_types", "kind": "unused_data", "objects": ["n2.enemy.t06", "n2.enemy.t0A", "n2.enemy.t12", "n2.enemy.t13", "n2.enemy.t15", "n2.enemy.t17", "n2.enemy.t18", "n2.enemy.t1A", "n2.enemy.t1C", "n2.enemy.t1E", "n2.enemy.t21", "n2.enemy.t27", "n2.enemy.t28", "n2.enemy.t35", "n2.enemy.t37", "n2.enemy.t3D", "n2.enemy.t3E", "n2.enemy.t3F"], "reason": "Types with a ficha in p00:$4F45 (and dispatch entries) but no spawn list, wave or code path creating them was found; catalogued from the ficha only and never seen in the emulator (records of these types appear only when 0xE600 is used as scratch at transitions). Their ficha picture is rendered with the map_01 set; for 0A, 12 and 1E the ficha pattern is not even loaded there (flagged in the frame checks)."}
- {"id": "gap.unused_pieces", "kind": "unused_data", "objects": ["n2.boss.unused_pieces", "n2.item.special_capsule_unused"], "reason": "Boss piece drawings 0x1D/0x1F of p09:$BB01 are not selected by any boss record; special capsule classes 1, 2 and 6 (p08:$9094) are not placed by any capsule list. Catalogued from the tables."}
- {"id": "gap.laser_remains", "kind": "not_proven", "objects": ["n2.enemy.t3B", "n2.enemy.t3C"], "reason": "Types 0x3B/0x3C are created only when type 0x0F (stage 5 / return trip) is hit by LASER or EXTEND LASER (p02:$9809, p02:$985F). The capture runs never had a laser on screen while 0x0F was hit. Catalogued from code."}
- {"id": "gap.1up", "kind": "not_proven", "objects": ["n2.item.1up"], "reason": "Type 0x2B (1UP) only comes from two hidden blocks of stage 10 (block list p15:$A14D: columns 0x0B8 and 0x124, C = 2 -> invisible type 0x2E that becomes 0x28 + C + 1 = 0x2B when hit, p01:$72AC, p02:$89E8). The autopilot never hit them, so it was not seen. Catalogued from p00:$5265 and p02:$96AA tipo_2b_empieza."}
- {"id": "gap.screens_not_captured", "kind": "not_proven", "objects": [], "reason": "Decoded but not captured: interior prize NOTHING (p01:$7731) and the single-weapon prize (0xE3C0 step 8) because the autopilot forced 0xE444 = 2; PUSH SPACE KEY (p03:$B2CA) and LET'S START (p03:$B2EE) after F5 at THE END. No staff roll exists: the ending step table p10:$B99A has 14 steps (texts, pictures, the pilot scene the disassembly calls creditos) and no list of names; there is no name entry (only the HI SCORE code, p00:$5C12) and no password or option screen; stages start without a title card (p01:$6128 empieza_la_fase)."}
- {"id": "gap.map05_type11_pattern_F0", "kind": "quirk", "objects": ["n2.enemy.t11"], "reason": "In stage 5 the first frames of type 0x11 use sprite pattern F0 (p08:$9902), which the stage-5 set does not load: the real VRAM shows whatever the previous stage left there (the map_05 F0/8 byte mismatches of gap.vram_checks). The catalogue frame [map_05 first frame F0] is rendered with the stage-5 table and flagged in its checks."}
- {"id": "gap.transient_sprite_frames", "kind": "quirk", "objects": ["n2.player.metalion", "n2.player.explosion", "n2.player.r_drill"], "reason": "Ship patterns 00/15 and 04/8 mismatch in a few samples at the death (p00:$42DD has already replaced the patterns with the explosion pictures while the SAT still shows the ship) and on the first R.DRILL frame (p00:$42FE). One-frame transitions, not missing objects."}
- {"id": "gap.dynamic_offsets", "kind": "limit", "objects": ["n2.enemy.t38", "n2.object.stage1_rotator", "n2.object.falling_piece"], "reason": "Positions computed at run time are not fixed frames: the four sprites of the 0x38 snake trail each other (offsets vary), the stage-1 rotator draws a 14-row strip from a start row given by its direction, falling pieces are drawn at the map position they leave. The catalogue gives the drawings; the emulator proof matched them in the recorded name tables / SAT."}
- {"id": "gap.breakable_partial", "kind": "not_proven", "objects": ["n2.scenery.breakable"], "reason": "Breakable characters (p02:$8481) are stage map characters; the proof only matched the 2x2 A0 block of stage 9 in the recorded name tables. The breaking itself was not checked frame by frame."}
- {"id": "gap.label_names", "kind": "limit", "objects": ["n2.hud.meter_labels"], "reason": "The 25 meter label drawings come from p14:$9BD3 by index; their names in the frame list are the text the drawings show (the labels are pictures of text, not encoded strings)."}
- {"id": "gap.no_picture", "kind": "limit", "objects": ["n2.enemy.t21", "n2.object.c04"], "reason": "Catalogued without frames or PNG because the code gives them no drawing: type 0x21 has an all-zero ficha and no creator; class 4 (pod launcher) is skipped by the drawing routine p01:$6000 (the pods come out of the map characters)."}
- {"id": "gap.stage_map_limits", "kind": "limit", "objects": [], "reason": "stage_map.json: the per-type parameter B of the enemy list (IX+19) and the turret facing index are given raw, not translated into pictures or paths; the stage-0 wave (type 0x0B) and the level-10 filler nibbles were never active in the captures (level stayed below 10); the loop after EXTEND F5 (second loop) was not played to its end in the emulator. Spawn tables were decoded for every stage and checked against the enemy types recorded in play: no recorded type is unexplained (stage_map.md, Emulator check)."}
- {"id": "gap.series_names", "kind": "limit", "objects": [], "reason": "series_name is filled only where the game or the disassembly docs name the object (Metalion, Force Field, Option, weapon labels, Power Capsule...). The docs give no enemy or boss names, so enemies and bosses have series_name null."}
- {"id": "gap.objects_without_emulator_proof", "kind": "summary", "objects": ["n2.item.1up", "n2.item.special_capsule_unused", "n2.enemy.t3B", "n2.enemy.t3C", "n2.enemy.t06", "n2.enemy.t0A", "n2.enemy.t12", "n2.enemy.t15", "n2.enemy.t18", "n2.enemy.t1A", "n2.enemy.t1C", "n2.enemy.t1E", "n2.enemy.t27", "n2.enemy.t35", "n2.enemy.t37", "n2.enemy.t3D", "n2.enemy.t3E", "n2.enemy.t3F", "n2.enemy.t13", "n2.enemy.t17", "n2.enemy.t28", "n2.enemy.t21", "n2.boss.unused_pieces"], "reason": "All objects with an empty capture_proof (each is explained above)."}
- {"id": "gap.unmapped_in_emulator", "kind": "summary", "objects": [], "reason": "0 sprite (pattern, colour) pairs and 0 character-drawn records seen in the emulator are not mapped to a catalogued object.", "unmapped_sprites": [], "unmapped_chars": []}

| sal.screen.ending_bad | Other ending: WHAT IS HAPPENED!? / VENOM reincarnated / THE PREDICTION chapter 5 / FAILURE / GO FOR THE FIGHT!! | ending | Without Nemesis 2 or without the crystal (0xE30A = 0, forced by RAM poke in run S4): p10:$8F7F takes the other branch. | yes |
